units.source_text: 战争结束之后，和服的花样也有显著的变化。

en.t: After the war ended, kimono patterns also changed noticeably.

units.source_text: 他想起当年借助麻药绘出来的奇怪花样，

en.t: He remembered the strange patterns he had once drawn with the help of anesthetic drugs,

units.source_text: 拿到今天来看，或许干脆成了标新立异的抽象派了。

en.t: and seen today, they might well have become something boldly original and abstract.

units.source_text: 然而，太吉郎如今也年过半百了。

en.t: However, Taikichiro was now already past fifty.
